note: Stories picked by hand from Reddit's AI communities. Each entry links the original publisher, not the Reddit thread, and records the thread it was found in. Only add a story after opening the publisher's page and confirming the headline and date. Titles are the publisher's headline exactly as printed. The newsroom keeps only its newest 400 items (roughly the last day and a half), so add a pick the day it is published or it will not show.

items.title: OpenAI safety leader quits, warning AI company’s culture is ‘broken’
items.summary: David Robinson joins other insiders in urging industry to take more care over rapidly developing technology.

items.title: Sam Altman Says the World Is Going to Have to Suffer for the Glories of AI
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says the "world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of this technology."

items.title: Top Economist Warns AI Could Triple Unemployment Within a Decade — ‘What We Are Living Through…Is Unprecedented’
